title: Office Battlefield - The Payoff Matrix
summary: After scoring two workplace jokes with AI, Jason models their exchange as a payoff matrix. The numbers and game-theory vocabulary make his retaliatory message feel like proof that he has won.

portal.scene: Jason holds a phone before a scored payoff table over a chessboard; AI, coworkers, paths and office objects fill the surrounding ring.
